caption_verbatim: Figure 1. Normal anatomy of the craniocervical region. Drawings illustrate the articulations of the axis, atlas, and skull (sagittal view) (a), the median atlantoaxial joint (superior view) (b), the principal part of the tectorial membrane removed to expose the deeper ligaments (posterior view) (c), and the cruciform ligament removed to show the deepest ligaments (posterior view) (d).
pointers: No arrows/symbols; black text labels with thin black leader lines burned into the drawings (panel letters a-d are page text outside the images). a: Tectorial membrane (deep and superficial layers); Hypoglossal canal; Transverse ligament of atlas; Posterior longitudinal ligament; Anterior longitudinal ligament. b: Alar ligaments; Transverse atlantal ligament. c: Alar ligaments; Cruciate ligament (including transverse atlantal ligament). d: Apical dental ligament; Alar ligaments. Artist signature in each. Caption and images consistent; no mismatch.
topic: anatomy; ligaments (craniocervical ligaments)

caption_verbatim: Figure 2. Normal relationships within the craniocervical junction. Drawings illustrate the basion-dens interval (a), the posterior axial line, which is drawn along the posterior cortex of the axis (b), and the basion–posterior axial line interval (c). Horizontal line in c represents the range of acceptable basion positions.
pointers: No arrows. Thin black drawn lines on grey-background line drawings. a: short vertical black line between basion and tip of dens = basion-dens interval. b: long thin black line running along posterior cortex of axis (extended upward past the clivus tip) = posterior axial line. c: same line plus short horizontal black line with end ticks at basion level = range of acceptable basion positions / basion-PAL interval. No panel letters inside image (a/b/c are page text). Image and caption consistent. Page also holds Table 3 (not in this raw file).
topic: craniometry; basion-dens interval, basion-posterior axial line interval
